relevance_rank_note: Cerebrovessel proteome of non-demented human donors by APOE genotype (Ojo 2021). Table S2 lists retromer and ARF6-GEF changes in APOE4/4 vs APOE3/3, but the APOE4/4 donors are about 37 years younger, so very weak evidence. Added at the team leader's request with the confound named.

quote: Abundance ratio was generated by dividing each samples with the respective control E3/E3 sample used as a reference in the same plex for normalization of data (see Table 1 ).
system: Cerebrovessels isolated from post-mortem inferior frontal gyrus of non-demented control donors (Sun Health / NIH NeuroBioBank). Control APOE4/4 (n 6, mean age 45.8, 4 male) vs control APOE3/3 (n 6, mean age 83.0, 6 male). Vessel-enriched tissue (cell make-up not characterised here), TMT 10-plex LC-MS/MS, t-test on ln ion counts, no multiple-testing correction reported.
description: VPS35, the core retromer subunit that recycles receptors from endosomes, was lower in cerebrovessels of non-demented APOE4/4 donors than APOE3/3 donors: log2FC -0.58 (about 33% lower), -log10 p 3.21. The APOE4/4 donors were much younger (45.8 vs 83.0 years). Effect detail: the supplement prints log2FC -0.58; the column gives the same value as a linear fold, 2^log2FC.
summary: (APOE3/3 -> APOE4/4, non-demented human cerebrovessels, age-confounded) -> (less total VPS35)
location: Supplementary Table S2 (image), row Q53FR4 Vacuolar protein sorting 35 variant
human_check: Sign from the methods: each sample divided by the E3/E3 reference in its plex, so negative = lower in APOE4/4. Less retromer fits less endosome-to-surface recycling, but retromer is not ARF6-specific. Severe confound: the APOE4/4 donors are about 37 years younger than the APOE3/3 donors (and the APOE3/3 group is all male); the authors name the age bias as a limitation, so age could explain the difference. Values read by eye from the Table S2 image (2 decimals); effect = percent change converted from log2FC, p = 10^-(-log10 p), both approximate. The age-matched E3/E4 vs E3/E3 comparison (Table S3) does not list this protein among its 59 significant proteins. GFAP is also lower in the E4/E4 vessels (log2FC -0.96), suggesting a difference in cell make-up. Total protein in vessel-enriched tissue, so class 3.

description: PSD3 (EFA6D), an exchange factor that activates ARF6, was higher in cerebrovessels of non-demented APOE4/4 donors than APOE3/3 donors: log2FC +0.65 (about 57% higher), -log10 p 2.44. Coded against because it reverses the living-cortex biopsy result (37155564, PSD3 lower); its bearing on H2 itself is ambiguous, since more ARF6 activation could either aid or impair recycling. The APOE4/4 donors were much younger (45.8 vs 83.0 years). Effect detail: the supplement prints log2FC +0.65; the column gives the same value as a linear fold, 2^log2FC.
summary: (APOE3/3 -> APOE4/4, non-demented human cerebrovessels, age-confounded) -> (more total PSD3/EFA6D, an ARF6 activator)
location: Supplementary Table S2 (image), row Q9NYI0 PSD3 EFA6D
